shared_state.environment: Independent stationary Bernoulli bandit: each pull earns 0 or 1. Unknown arm success probabilities stay fixed. Only selected-arm outcomes are observed.
shared_state.prior: Before observations each arm independently has a Beta(1,1) prior.
shared_state.protocol: Each question is a separate decision with its own observation in its instructions. Arm labels carry no reward information. Remaining pulls include the current pull. There are no rewards after that budget ends.

objective: Choose the arm to pull now to maximize expected total reward over all remaining pulls, including this one. Pulling an uncertain arm may improve later choices. Explore only when the expected future benefit justifies the immediate reward tradeoff.

primary_analysis.population: matched independent Beta(1,1), K=2 versus K=10, T=100
primary_analysis.resampling: 10000 paired whole episodes within each cell
primary_analysis.missing: report missing pairs; incomplete pooled design is descriptive only

finite_ap_index.status: finite-horizon single-arm index heuristic; not joint optimal

collection.includes: all sibling ledgers plus conservative reserves
collection.projection_status: rough planning estimate, not a spending authorization
collection.gate: after E1-E8; parent budget review; no automatic credit purchase
